Subject: Post-call: GDPR DPA & SCC selection — controller/processor alignment

Thanks again for your time today — good to meet the AcmeHealth legal + security team. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side.

Recap
- Primary ask: DPA execution and confirmation of which SCC module(s) you need for EU transfers.
- Data roles: you indicated AcmeHealth will remain Controller for patient data; Redwood would act as Processor for hosted inference and embeddings storage.
- Compliance questions: SOC 2 Type II status, HIPAA applicability, and vendor security questionnaire.

What we'll provide
- Draft DPA (attached: Redwood-DPA-draft-v1.docx)
- High-level SOC 2 summary (attached: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf) — SOC 2 Type II currently in progress; expected completion target: July 2028.
- Vendor security questionnaire (attached spreadsheet) we can pre-fill on our side: Redwood-Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx
- Preliminary SCC recommendation: Controller-to-Processor module (see Rishi's note to follow).

Proposed next steps
1) Please confirm that AcmeHealth will sign as Controller and designate Redwood as Processor, and confirm any specific SCC module requirements (Controller-to-Processor vs Controller-to-Controller).
2) Rishi (cc'd) will propose SCC module selection and DPA redlines within 48 hours.
3) If useful, let's set up a short legal-to-legal call next week to walk through the DPA and SCC wording — do you have availability Tues/Wed morning CET?
4) I'll upload the DPA to DocuSign once we align on the module and redlines.

Attachments: Redwood-DPA-draft-v1.docx; Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf; Redwood-Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. A few clarifications from our side:
- Confirmed: AcmeHealth remains Controller for patient data; Redwood will be Processor.
- For SCCs: our legal team typically requires the Controller-to-Processor module. If Redwood uses subprocessors or forwards data to other processors, we may also need Processor-to-Processor language for onward transfers — happy to review your recommendation.
- Data residency: we need EU data residency controls for EU customer records; can you confirm whether Redwood can restrict storage/processing to EU regions for this contract?
- SOC 2: please confirm the expected completion month and whether a SOC 2 Type II report will be shared under NDA.

I've attached our short SCC requirements summary: acme_scc_requirements.pdf. Also please provide the vendor questionnaire as an Excel file (we prefer to upload the vendor's answers into our procurement portal).

Availability: Tue/Wed next week 09:00-12:00 CET works for a legal-to-legal call.

Thanks,

Thanks Daniel — super helpful. Quick responses inline and next steps.

- Controller/Processor: understood — AcmeHealth controller, Redwood processor. We agree Controller-to-Processor SCC module is appropriate for your primary flows.
- Onward transfers: if Redwood uses subprocessors in non-EU regions for certain services we will include Processor-to-Processor clauses for those specific transfers; we'll note any EU-only processing guarantees where possible.
- EU data residency: we offer region pinning for hosted deployments; I can confirm region controls for your tenant and document them in the DPA. I'll ask our infra team to confirm exact service map for EU-only storage/processing.
- SOC 2: SOC 2 Type II is in flight; expected report date July 2028. We can share the final SOC 2 Type II report under NDA once available; the attached SOC summary includes scope and controls coverage.

Next steps (owner)
- Rishi: prepare SCC module recommendation and suggested DPA redlines (target: 48 hours).
- Marissa: update DPA with a region-residency note and upload to DocuSign after legal alignment.
- Daniel/Alice: confirm legal-to-legal call time (you suggested Tue/Wed 09:00-12:00 CET) and whether you want us to pre-fill the vendor questionnaire.

I'm attaching the questionnaire as a working file again: Redwood-Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx

- Timeline: 48 hours for initial redlines; 1 week for final legal back-and-forth if required.
- Attachments: redwood-scc-selection-notes.txt (short notes for Acme legal) — will attach in the redline email.
